title: What fraction of the square is shaded?
description: A square holds a red quarter, a yellow triangle that is half of the red part, and a shaded piece that is three quarters of the triangle. A fraction of a fraction is found by multiplying, one step at a time. Keeko thinks the shaded piece is three quarters of the red part.
teaching_notes: One idea: a part of a part is found by multiplying the fractions, always measured against the whole square. Watch for students who skip the yellow triangle and take three quarters of the red square.

source: Figure 8.4: a square with a red top-right quarter, a yellow triangle inside it that is half of the red square, and a shaded part that is 3/4 of the triangle. What fraction of the whole square is shaded?
video_script.why: A learner sees that a fraction of a fraction of a whole is found by multiplying, one step after another.
video_script.substitution: the book's own square, with a red quarter, a yellow half of it, and a shaded three quarters of that
video_script.anchor: a square with a red top right quarter, a yellow triangle inside it, and a shaded part inside the triangle
video_script.wrong_move: takes three quarters of the red square directly and leaves out the half that makes the yellow triangle
video_script.payoff_line: Three thirty seconds of the whole square is shaded.

final_answer.spoken: three thirty seconds of the whole square

video_script.fraction_reading: one quarter, one half, one eighth, three quarters, three thirty seconds, three sixteenths
maths_rules: red square = 1/4 x 1 = 1/4 of the whole
yellow triangle = 1/2 x 1/4 = (1 x 1)/(2 x 4) = 1/8 of the whole
shaded part = 3/4 x 1/8 = (3 x 1)/(4 x 8) = 3/32 of the whole
video_script.design: The same square redrawn three times, once for each part, so the red quarter, the yellow half of it and the shaded three quarters of that are seen as parts nested inside each other.

beats.on_screen: small title card From your book; a square with a red top right quarter, a yellow triangle inside it and a shaded piece

marks.red: the top right quarter turns red
marks.yellow: a yellow triangle appears inside the red part
marks.ask: the shaded piece inside the triangle flashes

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about a square with colours in it.
<bookmark mark='red'/>The top right quarter of the square is red.
<bookmark mark='yellow'/>Inside the red part, a yellow triangle is half of the red square.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>A shaded piece is three quarters of the triangle. What fraction of the whole square is shaded?

beats.on_screen: the coloured square stays on the board; Keeko sits beside it

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the whole square cut into four equal parts; one part cut into two equal triangles; one triangle cut into four equal pieces

marks.four: the whole square is cut into four equal parts
marks.half: one part is cut into two equal triangles
marks.of: the word of is written with a times sign above it

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Cut the whole square into four equal parts, and one of them is the red square.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Cut the red square into two equal triangles, and one of them is yellow.
<bookmark mark='of'/>Each time the word of means times, and the whole square stays the one we measure against.

beats.on_screen: Given: red square = 1/4 of the whole; yellow triangle = 1/2 of the red square; shaded part = 3/4 of the triangle
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the red square is one quarter of the whole.
<bookmark mark='tri'/>The yellow triangle is half of the red square.
<bookmark mark='shade'/>The shaded part is three quarters of the triangle.

beats.on_screen: To find: the shaded part as a fraction of the whole square

marks.find: the words shaded part of the whole square are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the shaded part as a fraction of the whole square.

beats.on_screen: whole square = 1 square unit; red square = 1/4 × 1 = 1/4 of the whole

marks.whole: the whole square is written as one square unit
marks.red: one quarter of one is written as one quarter

narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>Step one, take the whole square as one square unit.
<bookmark mark='red'/>The red square is one quarter times one, which is one quarter of the whole.

marks.times: one half times one quarter is written
marks.mult: the numerators and the denominators are multiplied
marks.frac: one eighth is boxed as the yellow triangle

narration: <bookmark mark='times'/>Step two, the yellow triangle is half of the red square, one half times one quarter.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>One times one over two times four.
<bookmark mark='frac'/>The yellow triangle is one eighth of the whole square.

marks.times: three quarters times one eighth is written
marks.mult: the numerators and the denominators are multiplied

narration: <bookmark mark='times'/>Step three, the shaded part is three quarters of the yellow triangle, three quarters times one eighth.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>Three times one over four times eight.

marks.ans: the answer is boxed beside the shaded piece

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Three thirty seconds of the whole square is shaded.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the red square
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: 3/4 × 1/4 = 3/16 crossed out; the yellow triangle drawn between the red square and the shaded piece

marks.doubt: the working with three quarters and one quarter appears
marks.tri: the yellow triangle lights up between the red square and the shaded piece
marks.fix: the working is crossed out and the half returns

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the shaded part is three sixteenths, by taking three quarters of the red square.
<bookmark mark='tri'/>But the shaded piece is three quarters of the triangle.
The triangle is only half of the red square.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>The half cannot be skipped, so we multiply all three fractions.
